# RaceMap Data API samples

Pulled 16 Nov 2026 from RaceMap's permanent live-loop sample event
`66bf4318d1c783279d183dd3` (100 km Duathlon, 27 trackers, 3 crew with emoji bibs).

    https://racemap.com/api/data/v1/66bf4318d1c783279d183dd3/{current|distance|times|ranks}

No RaceResult `importId`s in this event — capture a real Epic feed as a second
fixture. Design: workspace `docs/racemap-gps-integration.md`.
